name: IRDSSTriageAcuity
title: IRDSS Triage Acuity
description: Prototype IRDSS triage-acuity scale. Level 5 is the highest acuity. This local scale requires formal clinical approval before production use.

concept.definition: Lowest IRDSS triage acuity; routine referral handling.
Moderate IRDSS triage acuity; routine referral handling with normal matching.
High IRDSS triage acuity; requires immediate notification and urgent referral handling.
Critical IRDSS triage acuity; requires immediate notification and processing as soon as possible.
Highest IRDSS triage acuity; requires immediate notification and deterministic emergency routing to the most capable eligible available facility instead of ordinary AI ranking.
